defects.why: The db_work pair has a nonempty lag profile and best_lag_ms -10000 in workload-04, and best_lag_ms -6000 in workload-03.

notes: The operator actions are useful, but the lag summary misstates two recorded results.

defects.quote: Correlation pairs for cpu_work and db_work vs response_time_p95_ms are BELOW_EFFECT in workload-03 ... or INSUFFICIENT_DATA in workload-04
defects.why: The workload-04 db_work pair is BELOW_EFFECT; only the cpu_work pair is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

notes: The recommendations are actionable, though one correlation status is misstated.

defects.quote: Only two load points were measured
defects.why: The evidence reports target rates for two evaluation windows but does not establish how many load points were measured across the full run.

notes: The proposed checks are useful, but the claimed total number of measured load points is unsupported.

defects.quote: Zero errors ... show no error-driven latency inflation
defects.why: Aggregate error counts cannot establish what contributed to the latency distribution or exclude unrecorded error behavior.

notes: It gives useful checks but miscounts findings and overstates what the failure and error evidence establish.
